decisions.reason: The label accurately conveys the number/quantity selected and is natural as a compact UI label.
Tiến lên correctly conveys moving/advancing forward in a short UI label.
The download-error message preserves the error, retry question, and newline structure naturally.

decisions.proposed_text: Quay về màn hình tiêu đề
decisions.reason: 返回标题 means returning to the title screen; the current Về tiêu đề is incomplete and sounds like returning to a title rather than the title screen.
Thử lại is the standard, accurate Vietnamese UI rendering of retry.
